changes.text: 疫情头七周的结果，他整理成一张表。南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水40,046户，霍乱死亡1,263人；兰贝斯公司供水26,107户，死亡98人。折算成每10,000户的死亡数，分别是315和37；伦敦其余地区为每万户59。OCR文本中“伦敦其余地区”一行的户数与死亡数无法复算出59，可能有识别错误，所以本篇只引用该行的每万户数。不过，南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司的头七周数字并非全部逐户查得。在部分只由该公司供水的分区，怀廷医生的调查只做到8月5日，后三周的供水是按头四周的比例推算的；斯诺认为这一推算“必定非常接近真实”。他据此得出结论：南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水户的死亡率是兰贝斯公司供水户的八到九倍。但这只是疫情头七周的结果。斯诺自己说明，随着疫情推进，两组的悬殊“没那么大了”，不过仍然十分显著。疫情头四周是每万户71对5，相差十四倍；第二个七周是每万户537对115，接近五倍。截至10月14日的14周里，按每万居民计，南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水户死亡153人，兰贝斯公司供水户死亡26人。这组数字把795例供水不明的死亡平均分摊到其他各供水来源，两家公司供水户的人口也是登记总长的估计数。兰贝斯供水户的死亡率低于全伦敦，但并不低于北区和中区。

The first seven weeks of the epidemic went into a single table. Houses supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company: 40,046, with 1,263 deaths from cholera. Lambeth Company: 26,107 houses, 98 deaths. Per 10,000 houses that came to 315 and 37; the rest of London stood at 59 per 10,000 houses. In the OCR text the house count and death count in the rest-of-London row cannot be recalculated to give 59 and may have been misread, so only that row's figure per 10,000 houses is cited here. Not all of the Southwark and Vauxhall figures for the first seven weeks were checked house by house, though. In some sub-districts supplied only by that company, the inquiry of a medical man, Mr Whiting, extended only to 5 August, and the water supply of the last three weeks was calculated in the same proportion as in the first four weeks; Snow judged that this calculation "must be very near the truth". Snow's conclusion: "The mortality in the houses supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company was therefore between eight and nine times as great as in the houses supplied by the Lambeth Company". That was the figure for the first seven weeks only. Snow himself wrote that as the epidemic advanced the disproportion "became not quite so great, although it continued very striking". In the first four weeks it had been 71 against 5 per 10,000 houses, fourteen times. In the second seven weeks it was 537 against 115 per 10,000 houses, nearly five times. Over the 14 weeks ending 14 October, there were 153 deaths per 10,000 living in houses supplied by Southwark and Vauxhall and 26 in houses supplied by Lambeth. These figures distribute the 795 deaths whose water supply was not ascertained equally over the other sources of supply, and the population of the houses supplied by the two companies is the Registrar General's estimate. The Lambeth figure was lower than London at large, but not lower than the north and central districts.

最后，本篇用的是扫描本的OCR文本，书中不少数字在识别时已经错乱，例如兰贝斯迁址的年份被识别成“185S”，化验部分的数值也有乱码。字迹清楚也不等于没有被识别改错：表九“伦敦其余地区”一行的户数与死亡数无法复算出该行的每万户59，本篇只引用其每万户数。因此本篇只用清楚可辨、能够复算的数字，例如表九中两家公司的户数、死亡数和每万户死亡数，以及肯宁顿的分户数字；迁址年份以斯诺脚注中的1852年为准；化验部分只写定性的差别。字迹清楚不等于逐户查得：表九中南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司的死亡数，有一部分是按比例推算的（见上文限定）。

Finally, this piece works from OCR text of a scanned copy, and many figures in the book came through garbled: the year of the Lambeth move reads "185S", and the numbers in the chemical test are corrupted too. Legible does not guarantee correctly read: in Table IX the house count and death count for the rest of London cannot be recalculated to give that row's 59 per 10,000 houses, so only the per-10,000 figure is cited for that row. Only figures that are clearly legible and can be checked are used here, such as the two companies' house counts, deaths and deaths per 10,000 houses in Table IX, and the Kennington figures; the year of the move follows Snow's footnote (1852); the chemical test is described only qualitatively. Legible is not the same as ascertained house by house: part of the Southwark and Vauxhall death count in Table IX was calculated in proportion (see the limits above).

dispositions.rationale: 复算确认：1,422÷256,423×10,000≈55，不是59；两家公司那两行可以复算（315、37）。“伦敦其余地区”一行删去户数和死亡数，只保留斯诺给出的每万户59，并加注说明该行在OCR文本中无法复算、可能有识别错误。中英文同步修改，其余内容不变。
